# Berk Purifier

> > Berk Purifier is a China-based manufacturer of household and commercial air purification solutions featuring HEPA and UV filtration technology.

Berk Purifier specializes in designing and manufacturing air purifiers for both residential and commercial applications, serving global markets with factory-direct pricing and customizable solutions. The company operates through multiple language portals including Japanese and Korean versions of their website.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filter technology
- UV air purification
- Commercial air purifiers
- Household air cleaners
- Aromatherapy air purifier
- Humidifier air purifier
- CADR rating
- Pet air purifier
- Whole-home air purifier
- Factory-direct pricing
- Product customization
- Shenzhen Sepitek Cleaning Technology
- Berk D9L model
- Berk D20S model
- Air quality solutions
